text: Seajets, the Greek ferry company, is a private company founded in 1989 as Dolphin Sea Lines by Panagiotis ("Takis") Iliopoulos and his son Marios Iliopoulos, who the article's infobox lists as owner.
short: Seajets was founded by Panagiotis and Marios Iliopoulos; Marios Iliopoulos is listed as owner.
